Revibe · My Account redesign

Customer notifications — current vs proposed

Every return journey beat by beat: the channels the customer is notified on today versus what we propose under the new My Account design. The three return journeys are backed by the 15 official emails — tap any node marked ✉ to see the real email. Flip the toggle to see what we'd add.

Source of truth & open items. For the three return journeys the Email column is the 15 official emails (confirmed). Current WhatsApp is pending confirmation — shown as email-only for now; the steps that already send WhatsApp will be flipped on once confirmed. Push is a proposal (not in the system yet). Order/shipment and compensation email sets aren't collected yet, so those journeys stay a draft.

Spotlight
Reading it. Nodes are grouped by lifecycle phase. A node is “changed” when the proposed channel set differs from today’s; a ✉ marks a node with a real email; an amber “gap” node has no message today. Trigger dot: teal = customer action, grey = system/ops event.
Scope. The 15 official emails cover the change-of-mind / issue / warranty return flows. Escalation and return-leg emails are mapped to the nearest event and flagged where they over-communicate. Order/shipment + compensation email sets, and the dynamic_edd sandbox, are out of scope here. Spec: docs/artifact/notifications-flow.md.
